lines.2: Mana sat down beside my desk.
lines.3: 「Tsushima. Did you watch yesterday's soccer match?」
lines.4: 「Yeah. The score was exactly what you said. ...If the forward had scored there, my prediction would've been right too.」
lines.5: 「A loss is a loss. Hand over the meal ticket.」
lines.7: 「Thanks as always. That makes me five wins and two losses.」
lines.8: 「Which match do we bet on next? I'll give you a handicap. You can pick.」
lines.9: 「Damn it, don't underestimate me. I'll get the next one... I know a fair bit about soccer myself.」
lines.10: 「Idiot. I play the real thing, remember? You only know it from games. Just admit you lost already.」
lines.11: 「Not a chance. I'm still in this.」
lines.12: 「This one might be fun to bet on. Spain versus Germany.」
lines.13: 「No, China versus Bahrain would be the connoisseur's choice.」
lines.16: I could've sworn Yoshimi just shot me a glare.
lines.17: 「What's wrong? You're spacing out. Got a fever or somethin'?」
lines.18: Mana put a hand on my forehead.
lines.20: 「Sato, may I speak with you about student council business?」
lines.26: 「Mana, can come with me a moment?」
lines.27: 「If it's the bathroom, go by yourself.」
lines.31: 「Getting too close to newlywed couple not good. You get burned.」
lines.32: 「You mean Yoppi and Tsushima? Don't think we need to be that careful.」
lines.33: 「...This why people say you cannot read room...」
lines.36: 「Hey, why's that idiot Mana lying there?」
lines.37: 「She delicate, so one thing I say hurt her. But good medicine.」
lines.38: 「What's up? Why'd you call me here?」
lines.39: No one else was in the student council office at lunch.
lines.40: 「The Princess is waiting in the cafeteria, you know?」
lines.44: 「I love you too, Leo. We're a couple trying to be happy together, right?」
lines.46: 「--Then why were you talking so happily with Mana?」
lines.48: 「I told you, didn't I? That from now on, I'd be happy if you looked only at me.」
lines.51: 「--Then stop chatting so happily with Mana.」
lines.54: Her intensity caught me completely off guard.
lines.55: 「I'm not interested in Mana that way at all, okay?」
lines.57: 「She's just a classmate I'm friends with, same as always--」
lines.58: 「No. Mana can't read the room, and she's stupid. What if she gets the wrong idea?」
lines.60: 「You're not looking only at me, Leo.」
lines.61: 「Watch how I interact with boys, and rethink the way you're acting.」
lines.62: Yoshimi rested a hand on my arm.
lines.65: She tugged it neatly into place.
lines.66: For a moment it tightened hard around my neck.
lines.67: 「...Maybe this sounds controlling, but I really do love you, Leo...」
lines.69: 「...This is so the two of us can be happy together.」
lines.71: 「Come on. Let's go. Ellie's waiting for us.」
lines.72: She was back to the same gentle Yoshimi as always.
lines.73: W-was she emotionally unstable or something?
lines.74: I'd better be a little careful.
